title: elatostema longeacuminatum
intro: Elatostema longeacuminatum, commonly known as Long-Pointed Elatostema, is a plant species belonging to the family Urticaceae, native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The plant is also believed to possess therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and anti-anxiety effects. Elatostema longeacuminatum contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
